Docusign Envelope ID: 88E445D9-D048-884D-8278-F75F04E4C772

  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  MAY 11, 2026

  A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Torosis at 5:30 p.m., on
  Monday, May 11, 2026, at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street, Santa Monica, CA.

  Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Caroline Torosis
  Councilmember Lana Negrete
  Councilmember Dan Hall
  Councilmember Ellis Raskin
  Councilmember Barry Snell
  Councilmember Natalya Zernitskaya

  Absent:  Mayor Pro Tem Jesse Zwick

  Also Present:  City Manager Oliver Chi
  City Attorney Heidi von Tongeln
  Interim City Clerk Denise Anderson-Warren

  CONVENE/PLEDGE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 5:30 p.m., with all
  members present except Mayor Pro Tem Zwick. Councilmember Snell led
  the assemblage in the Pledge of Allegiance.

  STATEMENT OF  The City of Santa Monica Statement of Accountability (Land
  ACCOUNTABILITY  Acknowledgement) was read into the record by Councilmember
  (LAND  Zernitskaya.
  ACKNOWLEDGEMENT)

  LEVINE ACT  No Councilmembers made disclosures regarding the Levine Act (Govt Code
  DISCLOSURE  Section 84308).

  PUBLIC INPUT FOR  There were no members of the public present to comment on Closed Session
  CLOSED SESSION ONLY: items.

  CLOSED SESSIONS  On order of the Mayor, the City Council recessed at 5:32 p.m., to consider
  Closed Sessions and returned at 6:47 p.m., with all members present, to
  report the following:

  5.A. Public employee appointment - Gov. Code § 54957(b): consider
  public employee appointment; title: City Clerk; Gov. Code §
  54957.6: conference with labor negotiator; City negotiator:
  Mayor/City Manager; unrepresented employee: City Clerk

  The Mayor advised this matter was heard, with no reportable action taken.

  1  May 11, 2026
 Docusign Envelope ID: 88E445D9-D048-884D-8278-F75F04E4C772

  ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the City Council meeting adjourned at 6:47 p.m.

  ATTEST:  APPROVED:

  Denise Anderson-Warren  Caroline Torosis
  Interim City Clerk  Mayor

  2  May 11, 2026
